sensors.name: line tracker, brightness of the floor in %

control_flow: followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 %, curve left; else if it reads above 70 %, curve right; else drive straight on.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line with the line tracker.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker reads below 30 % (black line); second: the line tracker reads above 70 % (white band or peach floor)

branches.outcome: the floor under it is black: it curves left
the floor under it is bright: it curves right
the reading is between 30 % and 70 %: it drives straight on

equivalence_classes: beside the line on its white band
away from the line on the plain floor
input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left while the tracker reads below 30 %, drives straight while it reads between 30 % and 70 %, and curves right while it reads above 70 %
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line, facing along it, in bright light
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the white band, again and again as it drives
scenarios.title: Follows the line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end

uncertainties: Between 30 % and 70 % the tracker reads only for a moment at the edge of the black core, so the straight-on outcome is brief.
On the plain floor the tracker reads 83 %, above 70, so your program curves right without end there; you didn't say what it should do without a line.
You didn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do there.
